parsed.claim: For any velocity family v and any T, the lintegral over Ico 0 T of t ↦ vorticityNorm (v · t) is the lintegral of some measurable minorant g. So the lintegral in the statement is the lower (measurable-minorant) integral. This is the only reading under which the '= ⊤' claim is meaningful, and it is the reading the '< ⊤' local bounds use. It does not itself prove measurability of the witness.
parsed.lean:
open scoped ENNReal

theorem probe_vorticity_lintegral_lower (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ g ≤ (fun t => Euler.vorticityNorm (v · t)) ∧
      (∫⁻ t in Set.Ico (0:ℝ) T, Euler.vorticityNorm (v · t)) = ∫⁻ t in Set.Ico (0:ℝ) T, g t := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hle, heq⟩ := MeasureTheory.exists_measurable_le_lintegral_eq
    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ico (0:ℝ) T)) (fun t => Euler.vorticityNorm (v · t))
  exact ⟨g, hg, hle, heq⟩
